title: The Future of LMS
summary: Why is this the future of LMS for remote regions who may not be able to afford such systems? Can teachers manage a Google Sheet? Yes? Good, then they can upload their courses. Donors can assist with the cost of the AI and LMS system by purchasing tokens. Tokens can either be sent to a general emergency fund, which will give tokens to schools that need them, and there will be an option to donate to preferred institutions. This means even people in the most remote villages with limited options for LMSs can access great educational technology. #dfatcambodia
